ticket.title: miter audit reports a clean pass at the meta-harness root while 60 files are over the threshold
ticket.description: Run from the 12-repo workspace root, miter audit --threshold 200 prints AUDIT PASSED: No files exceed 200 lines. Run from inside storypole it finds 10 files over 200, and wc -l across the workspace finds 3 files over the hard 250 ceiling plus 60 in the 200-250 band. The tool therefore cannot stand in for the per-repo CI loop, which is the only thing currently catching ceiling violations. Fix: when the target path is not itself a cargo package, discover member repositories (this is gaugeblock-workspace topology, GB-189) and audit each, reporting a per-repo table and a non-zero exit on violations.
acceptance_criteria: miter audit at the meta-harness root reports the same violations as running it in each of the 11 members
Exit code is non-zero when any file exceeds the threshold

verification_receipt.summary: audit_root_with_members + non-zero exit; root @250 passes 0 with exit 0, root @200 reports 70 with exit 1, per-repo @250 sums to 0; 162 engine tests green; cause was the meta .gitignore ignoring member checkouts, not a broken walk
